correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md and its assumptions (unit normalized h1, Plancherel Fourier convention, whole frequency axis, a>0, full L2). For fixed x integrate |V_h f(x,xi)|^2 over all xi by Plancherel to obtain exact H_a=M_{F_a}, F_a(t)=∫_{t-a}^{t+a}2u² e^{-u²}/sqrt(pi) du. Derivative w(t+a)-w(t-a) yields unique outer stationary root b=a coth(ab)>a and, for a>1, inner valley u=a tanh(au); center has F_a(0)=8a(1-a²)e^-a²/sqrt(pi), at a=1 first nonzero quartic positive. The outer-versus-central height difference has strictly positive derivative 2[w(a)-w(a+b)] for a>1 and opposite signs at endpoints, establishing unique sharp global switch. On every open monotonic branch, analytic changes of variables make pushforward spectral measures AC, finite nonzero-level fibers show no point spectrum, inverse-branch counts give 2/4/6 a.e. multiplicities. Explicit independent bisections recovered a*=1.07766362837624 and b*=1.23823662176807; numerical evidence is supplemental to the infinite-a derivative proof. No bounded-frequency rectangle or higher Hermite order is claimed.
